text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I did it! A victory to achieve my goal, 
taken fair and square-!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we absolutely, positively have to 
go dedicate this star to Goryokaku!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? Well, look~! Stars just 
naturally look good with stars, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Besides... sightseeing around Goryokaku 
with you is really fun, Trainer. *mumble 
mumble*...
And after finishing our tour of Goryokaku—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, about my next race... I want to 
run in the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
For the last Takarazuka Kinen, I was 
allowed to run thanks to the mercy of my 
cult-like fans. But...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"This time, I want to earn the votes with 
my own strength and qualify fair and 
square!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Bundling countless hopes and wishes 
together, here at Nakayama at the year's 
end.
choice_data_list: …Okay, let's go for the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Are you sure? Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"The final showdown of my Senior Year is 
finally here. This is my Goryokaku—I will 
never lose!"
